# Tidepool — Landing Page Build Plan

**Global system:** Sand-white base (#FAF7F2), deep-teal text (#10403B), seafoam washes (#CFE8DF), coral CTAs (#F0654B). Headlines in Fraunces (soft serif), body in Inter. Rounded cards, gentle wave SVG dividers, calm water photography.

**1. Nav.** Sticky, sand background with slight blur. Left: tide-ring logo mark + wordmark; center: Product, Rituals, Pricing; right: coral pill button "Start free."

**2. Hero.** Centered single column. H1: *"Your team's week, in one gentle rhythm."* Subhead: "Tidepool turns Monday planning into a ten-minute ritual your team actually keeps." Two CTAs: "Start free — no card" / "Watch 90-second demo." Below: product screenshot of a shared week board, slightly tilted, floating on a seafoam gradient with a wave crest behind it.

**3. Proof strip.** One muted line — "Trusted by 2,000+ teams of 3–15" — plus six grayscale fictional studio logos. Low-contrast teal, no cards.

**4. The problem.** Two-column. Left, oversized serif pull-quote: "Slack scatters it. Docs bury it. Monday meetings eat it." Right: two sentences naming the pain, no jargon.

**5. How it works.** Three horizontal cards on seafoam, numbered 01–03 with line icons: *Monday Pulse* (5-min check-in), *Midweek Drift* (nudges when plans slip), *Friday Reflector* (what carried over). Copy stays imperative and short.

**6. Feature bento.** 2×2 grid: Shared Week View, Capacity Tides (load bars that literally fill like water), Priorities Swimlanes, Async Standups. Each card: micro-screenshot + one sentence.

**7. Testimonial.** Full-bleed deep-teal band. One white serif quote, coral attribution, small circular headshot. Nothing else.

**8. Pricing.** Two flat cards — Crew ($6/user) and Pod ($12, adds retros) — plus a ghost "Dock" card, free for teams of ≤3. Monthly/yearly toggle.

**9. Final CTA.** Centered on sand-to-seafoam gradient with a slow animated wave. H2: *"Catch the next tide."* One coral button, footnote "Free for teams of three."

**10. Footer.** Four slim link columns on sand, tiny tide-chart motif, copyright.
final:
# Tidepool — Revised Landing Page Plan

*Key upgrades: sharper hero promise, real proof instead of logo soup, objection-handling, and a stronger ritual thread throughout.*

**Global system:** Sand base (#FAF7F2), deep-teal ink (#10403B), seafoam washes (#CFE8DF), coral CTAs (#F0654B). Fraunces display with italic accents; Inter for UI. Wave SVGs only at section breaks; slow 300ms eases; exactly one coral action per viewport.

**1. Nav.** Sticky, blurred sand. Tide-ring mark left; Product, Rituals, Pricing center; "Log in" ghost link + coral "Start free" pill right.

**2. Hero.** Eyebrow: "For teams of 3–15." H1: *"The weekly plan your team actually keeps."* Sub: "Tidepool turns Monday planning into a ten-minute ritual — then keeps the week honest by Friday." CTAs: "Start free — no card" / "Watch 90-sec demo." Annotated week-board screenshot with floating chips ("Maya capped at 3 priorities," "2 tasks drifted → rescheduled") on a seafoam crest.

**3. Proof strip.** Stat chips instead of a logo wall: "2,000+ teams," "10-min median planning," "38% fewer status meetings." Optional muted-teal logos beneath.

**4. Problem.** Two-column. Left: serif pull-quote, *"Slack scatters it. Docs bury it. Monday meetings eat it."* Right: a concrete scene — "By Wednesday the whiteboard photo is buried, and nobody remembers who owns the launch." Visual: scattered sticky notes dissolving into a calm tide line.

**5. The ritual.** Horizontal Mon→Wed→Fri timeline, numbered: Monday Pulse (5-min check-in), Midweek Drift (nudges when plans slip), Friday Reflector (what carries over). Imperative copy, line icons.

**6. Beneath the surface.** 2×2 bento, differentiators only: Capacity Tides (load bars fill like water), Swimlanes, Async standups, two-way Slack/Calendar sync. Closing line: "No new inbox. No standup theater."

**7. Testimonial.** Full-bleed deep-teal band. One white serif quote with a metric: *"Planning went from 45 minutes to nine."* Name, role, headshot.

**8. Pricing.** Crew ($6), Pod ($12), free Dock for ≤3. Yearly toggle with savings anchor. Three inline FAQ lines (accounts, migration, security). "30-day tide-back guarantee" footnote.

**9. Final CTA.** Sand-to-seafoam gradient, slow animated wave. H2: *"Catch the next tide."* One coral button; "Free for teams of three."

**10. Footer.** Slim link columns plus a one-field "Monday Memo" signup — the ritual, delivered weekly.
